current_analysis: The split-screen layout effectively contrasts Zimbabwe's raw asset with Chinese corporate processing. However, it violates core constraints: text is burned into the imagery, the map uses a fake 3D gold foil effect instead of precise d3-geo data, and the 3D arrow and bright red flag clash with the premium, minimalist Souverain aesthetic.

improvements.current: Flat split-color dark blue with subtle noise.
improvements.suggested: Use Background Type A: a unified dark navy (#080d14) with a precise CSS dot grid overlay to unify the composition.
improvements.why: Establishes the signature Souverain data-viz aesthetic and removes the artificial split-screen line.
improvements.implementation: React CSS `background-color: #080d14` with a `radial-gradient` repeating pattern for the dots.

improvements.current: Embossed 3D gold foil PNG with burned-in text.
improvements.suggested: Accurate, flat vector silhouette of Zimbabwe with a 2px gold stroke and a semi-transparent dark fill.
improvements.why: Maintains geographic accuracy and aligns with the flat, premium vector aesthetic.
improvements.implementation: Use d3-geo with Natural Earth 50m, ISO code = ZWE. Render as an inline SVG `<path>`.

improvements.why: Reduces visual clutter and allows for elegant vector animation.

improvements.current: Burned-in text and a standard, bright PNG flag.
improvements.suggested: Remove the flag to maintain the strict color palette. Build the right side as a structured typographic data card using Ivory and Gold.
improvements.why: Bright colors like the red flag break the moody, premium aesthetic; CSS text ensures crisp rendering and dynamic animation.
improvements.implementation: React CSS Flexbox layout. Main titles in Ivory (#f0e8d8), numbers/accents in Gold (#c8a951).

improved_storyboard_prompt: A premium documentary style storyboard frame in portrait 9:16. Dark navy blue background (#080d14) with a subtle, precise dot grid pattern. Left side: A flat, minimalist, precise map outline of Zimbabwe drawn in thin gold lines (#c8a951). Right side: A minimalist layout with horizontal gold separator lines and abstract geometric placeholders for data. A simple, elegant gold vector arrow connects the map to the right side. Aesthetic is high-end, financial, geopolitical dossier. Deep contrast, flat vector style elements. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS in the image.
background_asset_prompt: Pure dark navy blue (#080d14) background with a perfectly uniform, minimalist dot grid pattern in a slightly lighter blue. Absolute geometric perfection, flat, no lighting variations. NO smoke, NO atmospheric textures, NO clouds, NO organic elements, NO fire.
animation_hints: The Zimbabwe map outline draws in using SVG stroke-dashoffset over 30 frames. The gold arrow scales in and slides from left to right using a subtle spring physics animation. The right-side text elements fade in and slide up sequentially (staggered by 5 frames each). The $400M and 50,000t numbers dynamically count up using Remotion's interpolate function.
